parsed.explanation: No trans-specific offence, no documented police/border targeting, and legal protections/hate-crime statute support low-severity consequences. Documented venues, Pride, mayoral support and a travel guide's 'widely accepts' signal social acceptance. Negative signals are uneven enforcement, inadequate hate-crime investigation, rural/venue friction, a Pride disruption and escalating anti-gender rhetoric; these create moderate social/justice risk but not organised targeting. Search-law case studies leave border/customs treatment unresolved. Because the record is detailed, silence on visitor violence is mildly positive but not safety. Absent functioning visitor remedies, below 0.75 anchors; absent repeated trans visitor denials/universal exclusion, above 0.55/0.45.
